name: UMaT Main Gate / Campus
description: The university's main campus, including Chamber of Mines Hall, Gold Refinery Hall and K.T. Hall halls of residence; reference point for this dataset.

name: Tarkwa (town centre)
description: Capital of Tarkwa-Nsuaem Municipal District and the main commercial hub students travel to for shopping, banking, and transport; centre of Tarkwa Zongo, the market, and lorry station.

name: Tarkwa Mine (Goldfields concession)
description: Large open-cast gold mine on the northwest edge of town; well-known directional landmark, not a residential area.

name: Tamso
description: Historic Fante settlement immediately south/adjacent to Tarkwa town and very close to the UMaT campus; popular, affordable student residential area with the Tamso Estate Junction landmark.

name: Aboso
description: Former Wassa West district capital ~9km from UMaT; a well-known older mining town with growing student residential uptake, connected by the Tarkwa-Aboso road.
source_note: OSM (Mapcarta), pop. 9,945 (78th most populous settlement in Ghana)

name: Akoon
description: One of the Fante communities named alongside Efuanta, Tamso, Aboso and Kwabedu as founding settlements of the Tarkwa area; close to campus and popular with students.
source_note: Named in Wikipedia's Tarkwa article; coordinates estimated (west of UMaT)

name: Efuanta
description: Locality near Kokwadu and Fawutinibua, close to Tarkwa Senior High School and TNA Park; one of the historic Fante founding communities.

name: Kwabedu
description: One of the historic Fante communities of the Tarkwa area, named alongside Efuanta, Tamso, Aboso and Akoon.
source_note: Named in Wikipedia's Tarkwa article; coordinates estimated

name: Nsuaem
description: Paired with Tarkwa in the district's full name (Tarkwa-Nsuaem Municipal District); a distinct settlement southeast of Tarkwa town.

name: Nkamponase
description: Residential suburb just north/northwest of the UMaT campus, well known to students (Assemblies of God Nkamponase and Nkamponase Community Center are local landmarks); one of the most popular off-campus hostel areas.
source_note: OSM POI references (Mapcarta business listings); coordinates estimated from POI cluster

name: Bankyim
description: Residential area near central Tarkwa with its own taxi rank (Bankyim Taxi Rank); popular student residential pocket.
source_note: OSM POI reference (taxi rank); coordinates estimated

name: Akyempim
description: Residential area close to Tarkwa town centre with its own taxi rank (Akyempim Taxi Rank); near Bankyim.
source_note: OSM POI reference (taxi rank); coordinates estimated

name: New Atuabo
description: Residential community on the outskirts of Tarkwa commonly referenced by students and hostel operators for affordable accommodation.
source_note: Locally known community name; coordinates estimated

name: Apinto
description: Seat of the Apinto Stool of the Wassa Fiase Traditional Area, under whose jurisdiction the Tarkwa mine's host communities fall; a named traditional/administrative area in Tarkwa.
source_note: Named in Gold Fields Ghana community-relations documentation; coordinates estimated

name: Tarkwa Station (Railway Station)
description: Historic railway station in Tarkwa town, a well-known directional landmark (also referenced via Tarkwa Railways Police Station).
source_note: OSM POI reference (Tarkwa Railways Police Station); coordinates estimated

name: Tarkwa Zongo
description: Predominantly Muslim/migrant-community suburb of Tarkwa town; a distinct, well-known named area.

name: Brahabebome
description: Residential suburb of Tarkwa referenced alongside Tarkwa Zongo as a notable named place within the town.

name: Cyanide Park
description: Named landmark/area east of the Tarkwa mine concession, used locally for directions.

name: Maxam
description: Small commercial/office node in central Tarkwa near Winners' Chapel International and TNA Park; used as a directional landmark.

name: TNA Park (Tarkwa & Abosso Stadium)
description: Multi-use stadium in Tarkwa, home ground of Ghana Premier League side Medeama SC; major directional landmark near UMaT.

name: Tarkwa Senior High School (Tarkwa SHS)
description: Well-known co-educational SHS immediately southwest of the UMaT campus; commonly used as a directional reference point.

name: Banso
description: Community southeast of Tarkwa town along local roads; used as an OSM locality reference point.

name: Akyem
description: Residential area south of Tarkwa town, roughly 5km from the UMaT campus.

name: Kokwadu
description: Locality southwest of Tarkwa town near the mine concession and Efuanta.

name: Nsuta
description: Site of the Nsuta manganese mine, situated east of Tarkwa town; a well-known directional/industrial landmark for the wider area.
source_note: Wikipedia (Tarkwa article: 'Nsuta manganese mine is situated to the east of the town'); coordinates estimated

name: Bogoso
description: Mining town roughly 30km north of Tarkwa along the Tarkwa-Bogoso road; outside typical daily commuting range but a well-known regional landmark near the edge of the 30km radius.
source_note: General regional geography; coordinates estimated, verify before use

name: Huni Valley
description: District capital of Prestea-Huni Valley Municipal District, northeast of Tarkwa; a recognizable regional town near the edge of the 30km radius.
source_note: General regional geography; coordinates estimated, verify before use

name: Damang
description: Site of the Damang gold mine, about 30km northeast of Tarkwa; at the outer edge of/just beyond the 30km radius.
source_note: Gold Fields Ghana documentation ('Damang mine ~30km NE of Tarkwa'); coordinates estimated
